display.purpose: Hero headlines and section headings. Editorial serif with genuine contrast against Geist body.

body.purpose: Body text, UI labels, navigation. Clean modern sans-serif.

shadows.name: brand
shadows.purpose: Primary button focus with violet glow

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions and animations

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA button with violet background and white text.
components.css: .btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-foreground); padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 90%, transparent); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97) translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-foreground); padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 600; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-muted); border-color: var(--color-foreground); transform: translateY(-1px); } .btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97) translateY(0); }

components.name: Bento Cell
components.description: Feature card with border, hover lift, and card background.
components.css: .bento-cell { border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-card); padding: 1.5rem; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .bento-cell:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover); }

narrative.overview: A design system for Mongolian business software that respects its audience's intelligence and time. No decorative flourishes, no corporate theater, no adapted-from-English templates. Every element earns its space with real information. The aesthetic is clean and confident: Instrument Serif headings carry editorial weight, Geist body text communicates with clarity, and a committed violet/teal palette gives the brand a distinctive two-tone identity.
keyCharacteristics: Serif + sans font pairing with genuine contrast

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet and teal are the only accent colors. No third accent without replacing one.

rules.name: The Balance Rule
rules.body: All h1-h3 use text-wrap: balance. All paragraphs use text-wrap: pretty.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as response to state.

dos: Use Instrument Serif for headings, Geist for body
donts: Pair border + wide shadow on same element
